purpose: Rules for scripts/dashboard_refresh.py: when ~/TIM-live may follow platform-main and restart the Control Center.
min_minutes_note: 60 min between restarts when a new commit changes more than the display, 20 min when every changed file is display-safe.
preserved_note: Results the live system writes into tracked files (the 72h acceptance monitor). They do not block a deploy; the agent backs them up, checks out the new commit and writes the live content back.
busy_note: busy_process_patterns always block a restart. deferrable_process_patterns delay it until the process is gone or max_defer_minutes have passed since the commit became deployable (the CI job uses its own PostgreSQL on 5434; a 20-second dashboard restart does not disturb it).

display_safe.note: Paths that only change what the dashboards show. The runtime restarts, but detectors, data path, configuration and scripts stay untouched.

studies.released_text: halt den dashboard agenten nicht an er soll weiter aktualisieren und das dashboard erweitern
studies.released_note: From this time the agent deploys every CI-green platform-main state again, with runtime restarts. The S-K study keeps running; restarts and code changes after this time are study deviations to note in its report.
studies.reason: Detectors and data path must stay unchanged while S-K windows are drawn; a mid-study change makes windows before and after incomparable.
studies.display_safe_note: Study tooling (sk_*, control_regime_study.py, sk_study.py) runs offline on backup copies and is not imported by the runtime.
